---
title: "ctDNA sampling by randomized group"
date: 2026-08-24
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

Sampling is summarized by randomized group. A patient is counted as sampled
when at least one sample date is recorded. A mutation-positive patient has at
least one recorded mutation (`n_mut > 0`) in a valid sample.

```{r}
#| label: ctdna-sampling-by-group

cohort_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"
)
samples_path <- here::here(
  "analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-ctdna-samples.parquet"
)
result_dir <- here::here("analysis", "04-implementation", "results")
summary_path <- file.path(result_dir, "ctdna-sampling-by-group.parquet")
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(cohort_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
samples <- arrow::read_parquet(samples_path) |>
  as.data.frame()
if (any(!samples$id %in% cohort$id)) {
  stop("ctDNA samples contain a patient absent from the cohort dataset.")
}

patient_samples <- samples |>
  dplyr::group_by(id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_attempted_samples = sum(attempted_sample %in% TRUE),
    has_valid_sample = any(valid_ctdna_result %in% TRUE),
    has_mutation_positive_sample = any(
      attempted_sample %in% TRUE & valid_ctdna_result %in% TRUE &
        !is.na(n_mut) & n_mut > 0
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

patient_data <- cohort |>
  dplyr::select(id, tx) |>
  dplyr::left_join(patient_samples, by = "id") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_attempted_samples = tidyr::replace_na(n_attempted_samples, 0L),
    has_valid_sample = tidyr::replace_na(has_valid_sample, FALSE),
    has_mutation_positive_sample = tidyr::replace_na(
      has_mutation_positive_sample, FALSE
    ),
    randomized_group = dplyr::case_when(
      tx == 0L ~ "External control",
      tx == 1L ~ "Invitation group",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(randomized_group))

sampling_summary <- patient_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(randomized_group) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    randomized_patients = dplyr::n(),
    patients_sampled = sum(n_attempted_samples > 0L),
    sampled_percent = 100 * patients_sampled / randomized_patients,
    attempted_samples = sum(n_attempted_samples),
    patients_with_valid_sample = sum(has_valid_sample),
    patients_with_mutation_positive_sample = sum(has_mutation_positive_sample),
    mutation_positive_percent_of_valid = if (patients_with_valid_sample == 0L) {
      NA_real_
    } else {
      100 * patients_with_mutation_positive_sample / patients_with_valid_sample
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

arrow::write_parquet(sampling_summary, summary_path, compression = "zstd")
```

```{r}
#| label: ctdna-sampling-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Patients sampled and mutation-positive by randomized group"
#| echo: false

sampling_summary |>
  knitr::kable()
```
